dialogs.autoscaleBody: Set how many processes {{worker}} may scale between.
dialogs.restartBody: {{worker}} will restart its pool processes. This only works when the worker allows pool restarts.
dialogs.addConsumerBody: {{worker}} will start taking tasks from this queue.
dialogs.shutdownBody: {{worker}} will stop. It only comes back if Docker or Kubernetes restarts it.
dialogs.rateLimitBody: Limit how often {{name}} runs on every worker, until the workers restart. Leave empty to remove the limit.
dialogs.timeLimitBody: Stop {{name}} after these many seconds on every worker, until the workers restart.
